items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Those days he played Val Kanbon, did he? Was it Val? [INTERVIEWEE] I thought he used to play Val. He could play too. He could play that horn. Him and old Kanbos could play good.

ctx.x: He was on the house back there. And after he bought a other one, after that he bought a other one, Joe, he said, he was around the corner from me, right around the corner. He had a little house. On Peer Street, Joe's over there. I remember Joe. Oh, when I was about to, my son. You know, Joe's was, never was small. Old was big and all like that. I remember him. I remember him. Was it the vowel? I thought he used to play vowel. He could play too. That joke could play their horn. That joke could play their horn.…
Those days he played Val Kanbon, did he? Was it Val?
